# personal-data-map

> Map personal data in SQL schemas: parse CREATE TABLE statements, classify columns by token-based name rules, flag special categories and trace subject links via foreign keys Python package `trysac-personal-data-map`, import name `personal_data_map`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
